classes/adept-917.name: Adept
classes/adept-917.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: Adepts are skilled with all simple weapons. Adepts are not proficient with any type of armor nor with shields.

classes/archivist-74.name: Archivist
classes/archivist-74.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: Archivists are proficient with all simple weapons and with light and medium armor, but not with shields.

classes/ardent-10.name: Ardent
classes/ardent-10.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: Ardents are proficient with all simple weapons, with all types of armor (heavy, medium, and light), and with shields (except tower shields).

classes/aristocrat-31.name: Aristocrat
classes/aristocrat-31.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: The aristocrat is proficient in the use of all simple and martial weapons and with all types of armor and shields.

classes/artificer-36.name: Artificer
classes/artificer-36.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: Artificers are proficient with all simple weapons, with light and medium armor, and with shields (except tower shields).

classes/battle-dancer-973.name: Battle Dancer
classes/battle-dancer-973.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: A battle dancer is proficient with all simple weapons. She is not proficient with any type of armor or shield.

classes/beguiler-100.name: Beguiler
classes/beguiler-100.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: Beguilers are proficient with all simple weapons plus the hand crossbow, rapier, shortbow, and short sword. Beguilers are proficient with light armor, but not with shields.

classes/crusader-115.name: Crusader
classes/crusader-115.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: As a crusader, you are proficient with simple weapons, martial weapons, light, medium, and heavy armor, and all shields.

classes/divine-mind-11.name: Divine Mind
classes/divine-mind-11.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: Divine minds are proficient with all simple and martial weapons, with all types of armor (heavy, medium, and light), and with shields (except tower shields).

classes/death-master-974.name: Death Master
classes/death-master-974.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: A death master is proficient with the club, crossbow (light and heavy), dagger, scimitar, scythe, sickle, and staff. Death masters are proficient with light armor but not with shields of any type.
classes/death-master-974.reviewNote: Scythe and staff are retained as source-only 3.5 proficiencies because the modern equipment catalog has no exact compatible ID; they do not affect modern attack proficiency.

classes/dragon-shaman-101.name: Dragon Shaman
classes/dragon-shaman-101.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: Dragon shamans are proficient with simple weapons, with light and medium armor, and with shields (except tower shields).

classes/dragonfire-adept-29.name: Dragonfire Adept
classes/dragonfire-adept-29.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: Dragonfire adepts are proficient with simple weapons, but not with armor or shields.

classes/drow-paragon-1000.name: Drow Paragon
classes/drow-paragon-1000.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: Drow paragons are proficient with all simple weapons, rapiers, longswords, and hand crossbows, and with light armor.

classes/dread-necromancer-75.name: Dread Necromancer
classes/dread-necromancer-75.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: A dread necromancer is proficient with all simple weapons and with one martial weapon of her choice. Dread necromancers are also proficient with light armor, but not with shields.

proficiencyChoices.label: Martial weapon proficiency
proficiencyChoices.sourceText: Choose one martial weapon when taking the first dread necromancer level; the choice cannot be changed.

classes/duskblade-102.name: Duskblade
classes/duskblade-102.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: Duskblades are proficient with all simple and martial weapons, as well as all armors and shields (except tower shields).

classes/dwarf-paragon-1001.name: Dwarf Paragon
classes/dwarf-paragon-1001.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: Dwarf paragons are proficient with all simple and martial weapons, with light, medium, and heavy armor, and with shields (but not with tower shields).

classes/eidolon-72.name: Eidolon
classes/eidolon-72.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: An eidolon gains no proficiency in any kind of weapons, armor, or shields.

classes/eidoloncer-73.name: Eidoloncer
classes/eidoloncer-73.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: An eidoloncer gains no proficiency in any kind of weapons, armor, or shields.

classes/elf-paragon-1002.name: Elf Paragon
classes/elf-paragon-1002.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: Elf paragons are proficient with all simple weapons, rapiers, longswords, shortbows, and longbows. Elf paragons are proficient with light armor, but not with shields.

classes/factotum-35.name: Factotum
classes/factotum-35.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: A factotum is proficient with all simple and martial weapons, and with light armor and shields (except tower shields).

classes/favored-soul-7.name: Favored Soul
classes/favored-soul-7.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: Favored souls are proficient with all simple weapons, with light and medium armor, and with shields (except tower shields). A favored soul is also proficient with her deity’s favored weapon.

proficiencyChoices.label: Deity’s favored weapon
proficiencyChoices.sourceText: Record the character’s deity-favored weapon; Favored Soul grants proficiency with that weapon.

classes/healer-77.name: Healer
classes/healer-77.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: Healers are proficient with all simple weapons and with light armor.

classes/hexblade-19.name: Hexblade
classes/hexblade-19.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: Hexblades are proficient with all simple and martial weapons, and with light armor but not with shields.

classes/incarnate-81.name: Incarnate
classes/incarnate-81.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: You are proficient with all simple weapons, light armor, medium armor, and shields (except tower shields).

classes/jester-975.name: Jester
classes/jester-975.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: A jester is proficient with all simple weapons, plus the rapier, sap, short sword, shortbow, and whip. Jesters are proficient with light armor and all shields save for the tower shield.

classes/knight-103.name: Knight
classes/knight-103.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: Knights are proficient with all simple and martial weapons and with all armor (heavy, medium, and light) and all shields (except tower shields).

classes/lurk-12.name: Lurk
classes/lurk-12.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: Lurks are proficient with all simple and martial weapons, with light armor, and with shields (except tower shields).

classes/magewright-1029.name: Magewright
classes/magewright-1029.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: Magewrights are proficient with all simple weapons. Magewrights are not proficient with any type of armor or with shields.

classes/marshal-78.name: Marshal
classes/marshal-78.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: Marshals are proficient with all simple and martial weapons, with all types of armor (heavy, medium, and light), and with shields (except tower shields).

classes/mystic-26.name: Mystic
classes/mystic-26.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: The mystic is proficient in the use of all simple weapons. Mystics are proficient with light and medium armor and with shields (except tower shields).

classes/ninja-1.name: Ninja
classes/ninja-1.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: Ninjas are proficient with all simple weapons, plus the hand crossbow, kama, kukri, nunchaku, sai, shortbow, short sword, shuriken, and siangham. Ninjas are not proficient with any type of armor or shield.

classes/noble-27.name: Noble
classes/noble-27.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: The noble is proficient in the use of all simple and martial weapons, light armor, and shields.

classes/pixie-948.name: Pixie
classes/pixie-948.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: Pixies are proficient with all simple weapons, with the short sword, and with the composite longbow, but not with armor or shields.

classes/psychic-warrior-138.name: Psychic Warrior
classes/psychic-warrior-138.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: Psychic warriors are proficient with all simple and martial weapons, with all types of armor (heavy, medium, and light), and with shields (except tower shields).

classes/shugenja-8.name: Shugenja
classes/shugenja-8.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: Shugenjas are proficient with all simple weapons and with the short sword. They are not proficient with any type of armor, nor with shields.

classes/soulborn-82.name: Soulborn
classes/soulborn-82.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: Soulborns are proficient with all simple and martial weapons, with light, medium, and heavy armor, and with shields (except tower shields).

classes/spellthief-3.name: Spellthief
classes/spellthief-3.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: Spellthieves are proficient with all simple weapons and with light armor but not with shields.

classes/swashbuckler-23.name: Swashbuckler
classes/swashbuckler-23.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: Swashbucklers are proficient with all simple and martial weapons, and with light armor.

classes/swordsage-116.name: Swordsage
classes/swordsage-116.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: Swordsages are proficient with simple weapons, martial melee weapons (including those usable as thrown weapons), and light armor, but not shields.

classes/totemist-83.name: Totemist
classes/totemist-83.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: Totemists are proficient with all simple weapons, light armor, and shields except tower shields.

classes/warblade-117.name: Warblade
classes/warblade-117.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: Warblades are proficient with simple and martial melee weapons (including those usable as thrown weapons), light and medium armor, and shields except tower shields.

classes/warlock-4.name: Warlock
classes/warlock-4.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: Warlocks are proficient with all simple weapons and light armor, but not shields.

classes/warmage-5.name: Warmage
classes/warmage-5.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: Warmages are proficient with all simple weapons, light armor, and light shields; at 8th level they gain medium-armor proficiency.

classes/wilder-140.name: Wilder
classes/wilder-140.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: Wilders are proficient with all simple weapons, light armor, and shields except tower shields.

classes/wu-jen-6.name: Wu Jen
classes/wu-jen-6.proficiencyText: Weapon and Armor Proficiency: Wu jen are proficient with all simple weapons and are not proficient with armor or shields.

classes/psion-137.name: Psion
classes/psion-137.proficiencyText: Psions are proficient with the club, dagger, heavy crossbow, light crossbow, quarterstaff, and shortspear; they are not proficient with armor or shields.

classes/psychic-rogue-1050.name: Psychic Rogue
classes/psychic-rogue-1050.proficiencyText: Psychic rogues are proficient with all simple weapons, plus several named weapons, and with light armor but not shields.

classes/scout-2.name: Scout
classes/scout-2.proficiencyText: Scouts are proficient with all simple weapons, several named weapons, and light armor, but not shields.

classes/soulknife-139.name: Soulknife
classes/soulknife-139.proficiencyText: Soulknives are proficient with all simple weapons, their own mind blades, light armor, and shields except tower shields.

classes/barbarian-89.name: Barbarian
classes/barbarian-89.proficiencyText: A barbarian is proficient with all simple and martial weapons, light armor, medium armor, and shields except tower shields.

classes/cleric-91.name: Cleric
classes/cleric-91.proficiencyText: Clerics are proficient with all simple weapons, all armor, and shields except tower shields.

classes/fighter-93.name: Fighter
classes/fighter-93.proficiencyText: A fighter is proficient with all simple and martial weapons, all armor, and shields including tower shields.

classes/paladin-95.name: Paladin
classes/paladin-95.proficiencyText: Paladins are proficient with all simple and martial weapons, all armor, and shields except tower shields.

classes/ranger-96.name: Ranger
classes/ranger-96.proficiencyText: A ranger is proficient with all simple and martial weapons, light armor, and shields except tower shields.

classes/sorcerer-98.name: Sorcerer
classes/sorcerer-98.proficiencyText: Sorcerers are proficient with all simple weapons and are not proficient with armor or shields.

classes/druid-92.name: Druid
classes/druid-92.proficiencyText: Druids are proficient with club, dagger, dart, quarterstaff, scimitar, sickle, shortspear, sling, spear, natural attacks of wild-shape forms, light and medium nonmetal armor, and wooden shields except tower shields.

classes/wizard-99.name: Wizard
classes/wizard-99.proficiencyText: Wizards are proficient with club, dagger, heavy crossbow, light crossbow, and quarterstaff, but not armor or shields.

classes/monk-94.name: Monk
classes/monk-94.proficiencyText: Monks are proficient with club, light or heavy crossbow, dagger, handaxe, javelin, kama, nunchaku, quarterstaff, sai, shuriken, siangham, and sling; they are not proficient with armor or shields.

classes/rogue-97.name: Rogue
classes/rogue-97.proficiencyText: Rogues are proficient with all simple weapons, plus the hand crossbow, rapier, sap, shortbow, and short sword; they are proficient with light armor but not shields.
